feat.title: The agentic era of software
feat.ex: Agents now read the repo, write code, run tests and open pull requests. What changes for developers, how we use them safely and how they make their way into our clients’ products.

rest.title: Why startups need a technical co-founder
rest.ex: You have the vision and domain knowledge, but without someone owning the technology you end up managing vendors. What a technical co-founder does and how Betacode Ventures can be one.
rest.author: Pedro Gorrão

rest.title: Building applications with JavaScript/TypeScript as the backbone

rest.author: Pedro Gorrão

rest.title: How to transform legacy software into a modern product

rest.author: Marco Mendão
